limitations: This crosswalk documents the SPDX entry at the specified revision. It establishes neither representation equivalence nor a copyright classification or grant for a particular project.

The tags, build commit, job, XML, and JSON share the corresponding SPDX information lineage. The release records establish attribution and generation history. The two tag objects and the build commit report unsigned verification status.
The three job lines support a causal link for the bounded generated record. They do not enumerate every build input, show a file-level generation trace, or reproduce the entire build bit for bit.

The two annotated tags and the job's fetch, build commit, and push connect the inspected XML input revision to the generated revision containing the inspected JSON.
